verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly mention triggering agents from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail and agents that fix bugs/write code and open PRs, directly supporting automated diagnosis-and-fix-PR workflows for failed CI. However, there is no dedicated end-to-end CI-failure-diagnosis feature description, no example of the proposed PR format for a failing build, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow. missing for 10: dedicated CI-failure-diagnosis workflow documentation, concrete example of a CI-triggered fix PR, independent verification of this specific capability.
